formal: My brother requires a guarantor for a £25,000 loan in order to purchase a van for his work. My parents have asked me to act as the guarantor, and the plan is for me to sign the guarantor form this weekend. It is unusual for me to consult you regarding a financial decision of this kind; I rarely do so. I have no basis of my own upon which to judge a van loan, and I will sign the form without having decided for myself. What is your view?
